title: Jake Humphrey on The Room Where It Happened — 'How can it be that you can taste private equity in the food?'
summary: Jake Humphrey — UK broadcaster, NBC Sports/BBC presenter, and co-founder of The High Performance Podcast — drops a launch-week episode of his new show The Room Where It Happened ahead of Incorruptible's UK release (Penguin Life, May 28). Eric walks Humphrey through the structural betrayal of mission-driven companies via private equity, scale, and broken governance.
blockquote: How can it be that you can taste private equity in the food?
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on The Room Where It Happened
attribution_title: New podcast from UK broadcaster Jake Humphrey (NBC Sports, BBC, The High Performance Podcast)
